scheme_name: Chief Minister Career Advancement in Biotechnology
other_conditions: Must be a permanent employee of an academic or research institute in Kerala
Must be officially sponsored by the employer/head of the institution with a commitment to depute the candidate for research/training
Must possess a Ph.D. degree in biotechnology‑related subjects
Must have a proven record of independent research evidenced by publications in peer‑reviewed indexed journals and patents
Must not discontinue the fellowship without prior approval of KSCSTE/KBC; if discontinued, the fellow must refund the expenditure incurred
Pay and allowances during the fellowship period will be paid by the institution
benefits_summary: USD 1500 per month for overseas host institutions or INR 50,000 per month for domestic hosts, plus a contingency grant up to INR 50,000 for travel and related expenses.
